verdict.rationale: Daily notes are a fair axis for a note-taking and knowledge-base app like Anytype, but the pack never shows automatic per-day note creation or a daily note as the default landing place. Reusable templates (anytype-docs-13, anytype-docs-22) and a calendar block (anytype-gh-1) appear in the pack. Neither is shown generating a note for each day, so the story is unevidenced.
